overview_description.description:
Kirusa, develops mobile value added services. The company offers KV.SMS, a voice SMS solution that allows mobile subscribers to send and reply to SMS messages with voice. Kirusa also operates Consumer Corner, an online site for information and resources on voice SMS. It serves mobile operators and service providers. 

The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in New Providence, New Jersey. It has sales offices in Paris, France; Delhi, India; and Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates, as well as research and development facilities in New Delhi and Bangalore, India.

product.name: InstaVoice
product.description: A cloud-based call completion service providing voicemails, missed call alerts, and reachability notifications via a smartphone app and carrier integration.

product.name: Kirusa Konnect
product.description: A cloud-based omnichannel Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS) enabling enterprises to engage customers via messaging, voice, chatbots, and APIs.

product.name: InstaVoice Channels
product.description: A voice-based celebrity-fan engagement platform delivering daily voice messages, videos, and live updates via SMS, RCS, or app.

product.name: InstaVoice ReachMe
product.description: A smartphone app offering voice-over-data calls, virtual numbers, and low-cost roaming for users to make and receive calls globally.

product.name: Kirusa IP Messaging and Chatbots
product.description: A service enabling enterprises to build chatbots and engage customers over OTT apps and RCS messaging for interactive communication.
